نرص (form I)

# نُرَصُّ (nuraṣṣu) /nu.rasˤ.sˤu/: first-person plural non-past passive indicative of رَصَّ (raṣṣa)
# نَرُصَّ (naruṣṣa) /na.rusˤ.sˤa/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of رَصَّ (raṣṣa)
# نُرَصَّ (nuraṣṣa) /nu.rasˤ.sˤa/: first-person plural non-past passive subjunct
